ticket.title: joiner fill produces no trace when the hole filler is a reasoning model
ticket.description: The GB-199 dogfood ran joiner fill on a probe function and it exited 1 with HTTP 500 empty response content from cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash at max_tokens 1024. sawhorse own diagnostic names the cause: reasoning models spend the budget in the thinking trace before completion content can be generated, so no candidate is produced and neither a Silver nor a Gold trace is spooled. The default must account for reasoning models, or be configurable per role, otherwise the only Gold-producing path in the suite silently yields nothing.

verification_receipt.summary: fill budget 1024 to 8192 via FillOptions with a --max-tokens override; joiner-core tests, clippy and fmt green; live joiner fill against cline-pass/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017 now completes in one attempt at tier Silver and spools the trace, outbox 15 to 17
